audience: staffing managers who check the booked shifts of each job in Staffwise

useCases.title: Read the booked shifts of a job
useCases.text: Read the shift details that Staffwise reports for one job over a date range, for example 1 to 30 November.

useCases.title: Review last week's shift report
useCases.text: Read the shift report of one job for last week. The tool returns the vendor data as Staffwise sends it.

useCases.title: Compare shifts across jobs
useCases.text: Read the same date range for each job the API key can read. Compare the results side by side.
